claim: Paper-stated 420 eV FWHM TES energy response applied at pixel-readout level before the complete retained O8 detector selection.

detector_contract.interpretation: MEGAlib MDDetector::ApplyEnergyResolution uses the third Gauss parameter as one standard deviation; the paper's 0.420-keV FWHM therefore corresponds to sigma=FWHM/2.354820045.

response_model.distribution: independent Gaussian per aggregated TES pixel readout
ordering: aggregate Cosima deposits by TES pixel
discard measured TES hits below 0.3 keV
sum surviving TES hits into event energy
apply W2/broad window and 50-keV active-veto selection
evaluate side-entry Compton/FoV topology with measured hit energies

uncertainty_95.method: independent exact Garwood two-sided 95% upper counts per background component and Clopper-Pearson two-sided 95% lower focused-signal acceptance, evaluated after the fixed event-level response realization

response_seed_ensemble.acceptance_contract: at least 32 replicas; the preregistered primary value is within three response-ensemble standard deviations and 20% of the ensemble mean; first/second-half means differ by no more than 10% for every audited metric

scope: This package changes detector response and derived selection only. It does not replace particle transport, source normalization, activity inventory, or trajectory scale authorities.
